newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL - ASSIDOMAN H1 PROFIT SEEN 33 PCT DOWN.
newsitem.headline: POLL - ASSIDOMAN H1 PROFIT SEEN 33 PCT DOWN.

text.p: Swedish forestry company AssiDoman was expected to post a lower profit after financial items of 819 million crowns for the first half of 1997, a Reuters poll of 13 analysts found on Thursday.
This would be a fall of 33 percent compared to the same period a year ago when it posted a profit of 1.23 billion crowns.
Forecasts varied between 735 million crowns and 935 million crowns.
For the full year analysts expected a profit after financial items of 2.08 billion crowns.
This was 12 percent lower than the average forecast made just before AssiDoman's posted its results for the first quarter of the year.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Aros, Carnegie, CI Nordic, Den Norske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Nordbanken, Salomon Brothers, Swedbank.
AssiDoman was due to release it half year report on August 12.
